_source: ComfyUI-DLSS5-Enhancer (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Blueforcer), read only at HEAD 796ed59 on 2026-10-04. Each text is str(exc) of the exception the pack raises, verbatim to the f-string at "from", with example values in its fields (paths under an example portable install, example SHA-256 values, driver 591.44). ComfyUI's execution_error carries exception_message = "{}\n{}".format(ex, tips) (execution.py, execute()): str(exc) plus a newline, tips being empty for these exceptions; realism_test.js checks each text with that newline too. The log lines after a blank line are examples in ReShade's log form built from the pack's own FEATURE_18_MARKERS (diagnostics.py:23-27); the native worker's own stderr wording is not in the pack's source, so worker_exit's log line is an example only. realism.hint() matches stable substrings of these; tools/realism_test.js checks every entry.

messages.from: dlss5/paths.py:164-177 (find_runtime; SETUP_HINT at 34-38)
messages.note: find_runtime takes the first candidate folder that holds the worker nvngx.dll (paths.py WORKER_NAME); here no DLSS5_RUNTIME_DIR, no config.json, and the pack's own runtime folder lacks it.
messages.text:
No DLSS 5 runtime was found. Searched:
  C:\ComfyUI_windows_portable\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\ComfyUI-DLSS5-Enhancer\runtime

Install it with:
    python_embeded/python.exe ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-DLSS5-Enhancer/install_runtime.py
or point the node at an existing DLSS 5 Visual Enhancer install:
    python ... install_runtime.py --runtime-dir <path>/bin/runtime
or set the DLSS5_RUNTIME_DIR environment variable.
